rationale: Ahmad brings deep expertise in AI-native hardware form factors and spatial computing from Apple Vision Pro and Leap Motion, while Grady has successfully navigated FDA regulatory pathways and commercialized AI-guided medical devices into DoD/VA markets—two complementary skill sets in building hardware + AI products at scale. At a hackathon focused on physical AI, Ahmad's conviction that AI hardware must be deeply integrated with generative models (not bolt-on) aligns with Grady's long-game approach to avoiding shiny objects and staying aligned with core objectives, making them potential thought partners on what the next wave of AI hardware should actually solve.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Grady Hannah — both are building at the intersection of AI and hardware/devices, and Grady's expertise in regulatory approval and commercialization for digital therapeutics could be a valuable sounding board for the new category of AI-native hardware Ahmad is pioneering at Midjourney.
